name: player-height
title: Fix clipped player under wrapped dufs header
description: The player page hard-codes the dufs header height (calc(100vh - 3.1em)), so a wrapped breadcrumb makes .head 97px instead of 49px and pushes the bottom ~47px of the player off-screen, hiding its control bar. Replace the magic number with a flex-column layout and verify short/long paths, narrow windows, resize and fullscreen. Also document that an untrusted https certificate does not hide the WebCodecs hint.
creator: otix
